# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: the client's weapon selection against script switches,
# a dry trigger and the select-fire switch.
# map mp_carentan, gametype probe_weapsel, joined allies, weapon m1carbine_mp
# Two shells, the gsc probe first:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=<p> SECS=120 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_weapsel mp_carentan
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:<p> --probe-weapsel --probe-secs 75
# The script switches to the pistol at 4 s, back to the primary at 8 s, empties it at 12 s and
# puts a loaded thompson in the primary slot at 20 s; the client pulls the trigger every 700 ms
# from 15 to 19 s and runs `weapalt` at 26 and 30 s, `weapon colt_mp` at 34 s and `weapalt`
# at 38 s, all from its settled join (WEAPSEL_FIRE, WEAPSEL_COMMANDS in probe.rs).
# !cmd is a usercmd as it went on the wire; !press a command and what PlayInput made of it.
# !trace clip and ammo are the non-zero entries as index:value.
# !server is every server command, tokens joined, control bytes as \xNN.
!cmd ms=0 st=6023 buttons=0 wbuttons=0 weapon=0 up=0 forward=0 right=0 angles=0,0,0
!cmd ms=531 st=6554 buttons=0 wbuttons=0 weapon=0 up=0 forward=0 right=0 angles=0,0,0
